selection.rule: Homepage events come from current RSS/advisory sources. CVEs are shown only when the source article/advisory mentions them.

items.title: Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices
items.summary: Taiwanese network-attached storage (NAS) appliance maker Synology warned customers to update their devices immediately due to a surge in C3RB3r ransomware attacks. [...]
items.title_zh: 群暉科技發布警告，針對 NAS 裝置的 C3RB3R 勒索軟體攻擊正在增加
items.summary_zh: 台灣網路附加儲存（NAS）設備製造商群暉科技（Synology）警告客戶立即更新裝置，原因是 C3RB3r 勒索軟體攻擊大幅激增。[...]

items.title: Over 1,000 GitLab servers vulnerable to ongoing RCE attacks
items.summary: Over 1,000 Internet-exposed GitLab servers are still unpatched against a maximum-severity flaw actively exploited in remote code execution attacks. [...]
items.title_zh: 超過 1,000 台 GitLab 伺服器易受持續進行的 RCE 攻擊影響
items.summary_zh: 超過 1,000 台暴露於網際網路的 GitLab 伺服器仍未修補一個最高嚴重性漏洞，該漏洞正被積極利用於遠端程式碼執行攻擊中。[...]

items.title: Ivanti patches two more Connect Secure zero-days chained in attacks
items.summary: Ivanti released security updates to patch two more Connect Secure (ICS) remote access gateway flaws that have been chained in zero-day attacks since at least October 1. [...]
items.title_zh: Ivanti 修補另外兩個在攻擊中被串聯利用的 Connect Secure 零日漏洞
items.summary_zh: Ivanti 發布了安全性更新，以修補另外兩個 Connect Secure (ICS) 遠端存取閘道器漏洞，這些漏洞至少自 10 月 1 日起就在零日攻擊中被串聯利用。[...]

items.title: Ivanti Patches Two More Zero-Days Exploited in Connect Secure Attack Chain
items.summary: CISA has added CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 to its KEV catalog after the Ivanti VPN flaws were chained in zero-day attacks. The post Ivanti Patches Two More Zero-Days Exploited in Connect Secure Attack Chain appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Ivanti 修補在 Connect Secure 攻擊鏈中被利用的另外兩個零日漏洞
items.summary_zh: 在 Ivanti VPN 漏洞於零日攻擊中被串聯利用後，CISA 已將 CVE-2026-111357 和 CVE-2026-118527 新增至其 KEV 目錄。這篇文章《Ivanti Patches Two More Zero-Days Exploited in Connect Secure Attack Chain》最早發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Alpine Linux rebuilds GitLab after attempted RCE attack
items.summary: Hackers attempted to exploit a critical GitLab vulnerability in Alpine Linux's development infrastructure on October 20-21, prompting the open-source project to rebuild its GitLab server and reset all passwords over concerns of a possible compromise. [...]
items.title_zh: Alpine Linux 遭嘗試性 RCE 攻擊後重建 GitLab
items.summary_zh: 駭客於 10 月 20 日至 21 日嘗試利用 Alpine Linux 開發基礎設施中的關鍵 GitLab 漏洞，導致該開源專案因擔憂可能遭受入侵，進而重建其 GitLab 伺服器並重置所有密碼。[...]

items.title: Malicious Claude Code Extension Served in Cursor Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: The extension performed host reconnaissance and attempted to create a reverse SSH tunnel. The post Malicious Claude Code Extension Served in Cursor Supply Chain Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 惡意 Claude Code 擴充功能於 Cursor 供應鏈攻擊中散播
items.summary_zh: 該擴充功能執行了主機偵察並企圖建立反向 SSH 隧道。這篇文章《Malicious Claude Code Extension Served in Cursor Supply Chain Attack》最早發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Your Mobile Carrier Stores Your Call Logs for Years
items.summary: Mobile carriers can retain years of call and text metadata, exposing sensitive details about customers' relationships, locations, and daily routines if breached. Cape examines the privacy risks of long-term telecom data retention and how its mobile service reduces exposure by automatically deleting call records. [...]
items.title_zh: 您的行動電信業者保存您多年的通話紀錄
items.summary_zh: 行動電信業者可能會保留多年的通話與簡訊元資料（metadata），若遭遇外洩，將揭露客戶的社交關係、位置和日常作息等敏感細節。Cape 探討了電信數據長期保留的隱私風險，以及其行動服務如何透過自動刪除通話紀錄來降低暴露風險。[...]

items.title: Florida Student Aid Website Hack Puts Data of 4.9 Million People at Risk
items.summary: The Florida Department of Education says SSNs and other personal data may have been exposed in a breach of its financial aid website. The post Florida Student Aid Website Hack Puts Data of 4.9 Million People at Risk appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 佛羅里達州學生資助網站遭駭，490 萬人資料面臨風險
items.summary_zh: 佛羅里達州教育局表示，其財務資助網站遭外洩，社會安全碼（SSN）和其他個人資料可能已暴露。該篇文章《佛羅里達州學生資助網站遭駭，490 萬人資料面臨風險》首次發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Revolve Data Breach Impacts at Least 200,000 People
items.summary: Hackers accessed its online shopping platform and stole customers’ personal and payment card information. The post Revolve Data Breach Impacts at Least 200,000 People appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Revolve 資料外洩事件影響至少 20 萬人
items.summary_zh: 黑客存取了其線上購物平台，並竊取了客戶的個人及付款卡片資訊。該篇文章《Revolve 資料外洩事件影響至少 20 萬人》首次發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Chainalysis Discloses Data Breach Following AI-Driven Cyberattack
items.summary: The attackers used offensive agentic techniques to access the company’s systems and internal tools. The post Chainalysis Discloses Data Breach Following AI-Driven Cyberattack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Chainalysis 在遭 AI 驅動的網路攻擊後披露資料外洩事件
items.summary_zh: 攻擊者利用具攻擊性的自主代理（agentic）技術存取該公司的系統和內部工具。該篇文章《Chainalysis 在遭 AI 驅動的網路攻擊後披露資料外洩事件》首次發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Northflank security breach leads to abuse of customers' AI API keys
items.summary: Cloud application hosting platform Northflank is warning customers to rotate all credentials and secrets stored on its platform after a security breach led to unauthorized use of customers' AI API keys. [...]
items.title_zh: Northflank 資安侵害事件導致客戶的 AI API 金鑰遭濫用
items.summary_zh: 雲端應用程式代管平台 Northflank 在發生資安侵害事件並導致客戶的 AI API 金鑰遭未經授權使用後，正警告客戶輪替儲存於該平台上的所有憑證與金鑰。[...]
